reason: The README clearly describes a DSH skill whose primary purpose is AI-assisted code review with severity grading, scoring, and text/HTML report generation.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 DSH 会话的代码审查技能插件，可按多步流程分析代码、分级问题、评分并生成文本和 HTML 报告。
summaries.en: A DSH code review skill that analyzes code through a multi-step workflow, grades issues, assigns quality scores, and generates text and HTML reports.

capabilities: Reviews code using a documented multi-step workflow
Assigns critical, medium, and minor issue severity levels
Scores code quality, security, performance, and maintainability
Produces text summaries and HTML review reports
